Paighambar, aap keh deejiye ke meri taraf ye wahi ki gayi hai ke jinnon ki ek jamaat ne kaan laga kar Qur'an ko suna to kehne lage ke hum ne ek bada ajeeb Qur'an suna hai
Jo neki ki hidaayat karta hai, to hum to is par imaan le aaye hain aur kisi ko apne Rabb ka shareek na banaayenge
Aur hamaare Rabb ki shaan bahut buland hai, us ne kisi ko apni biwi banaaya hai na beta
Aur hamaare bewaqoof log tarah tarah ki be-rabt baatein kar rahe hain
Aur hamaara khayaal to yahi tha ke insaan aur jinnaat Khuda ke khilaaf jhoot na bolenge
Aur ye ke insaanon mein se kuchh log jinnaat ke baaz logon ki panaah dhoond rahe the to unhon ne giraftaari mein aur izaafa kar diya
Aur ye ke tumhaari tarah un ka bhi khayaal tha ke Khuda kisi ko dobaara nahin zinda karega
Aur hum ne aasmaan ko dekha to use sakht qism ke nigehbaanon aur sholon se bhara hua paaya
Aur hum pehle baaz maqaamaat par baith kar baatein sun liya karte the, lekin ab koi sunna chaahega to apne liye sholon ko tayyaar paaega
Aur humein nahin maaloom ke ahl-e-zameen ke liye is se buraai maqsood hai ya neki ka iraada kiya gaya hai
Aur hum mein se baaz nek kirdaar hain aur baaz ke ilaawa hain, aur hum tarah tarah ke giroh hain
Aur hamaara khayaal hai ke hum zameen mein Khuda ko aajiz nahin kar sakte aur na bhaag kar use apni giraft se aajiz kar sakte hain
Aur hum ne hidaayat ko suna to hum to imaan le aaye. Ab jo bhi apne Parwardigar par imaan laaega use na khasaare ka khauf hoga aur na zulm o zyaadati ka
Aur hum mein se baaz itaa'at-guzaar hain aur baaz naafarmaan, aur jo itaa'at-guzaar hoga us ne hidaayat ki raah paa li hai
Aur naafarmaan to Jahannam ke kunde ho gaye hain
Aur agar ye log sab hidaayat ke raaste par hote to hum unhein waafir paani se seraab karte
Taake un ka imtihaan le sakein, aur jo bhi apne Rabb ke zikr se ai'raaz karega use sakht azaab ke raaste par chalna padega
Aur masaajid sab Allah ke liye hain, lehaaza us ke ilaawa kisi ki ibaadat na karna
Aur ye ke jab banda-e-Khuda ibaadat ke liye khada hua to qareeb tha ke log us ke gird hujoom kar ke gir padte
Paighambar, aap keh deejiye ke main sirf apne Parwardigar ki ibaadat karta hoon aur kisi ko us ka shareek nahin banaata hoon
Keh deejiye ke main tumhaare liye kisi nuqsaan ka ikhtiyaar rakhta hoon aur na faaide ka
Keh deejiye ke Allah ke muqaable mein mera bhi bachaane waala koi nahin hai aur na main koi panaah-gaah paata hoon
Magar ye ke apne Rabb ke ahkaam aur paighaam ko pahuncha doon. Aur jo Allah o Rasool ki naafarmaani karega us ke liye Jahannam hai aur woh usi mein hamesha rehne waala hai
Yahaan tak ke jab in logon ne us azaab ko dekh liya jis ka waada kiya gaya tha to inhein maaloom ho jaaega ke kis ke madadgaar kamzor aur kis ki taadaad kamtar hai
Keh deejiye ke mujhe nahin maaloom ke woh waada qareeb hi hai ya abhi Khuda koi aur muddat bhi qaraar dega
Woh Aalim-ul-Ghaib hai aur apne ghaib par kisi ko bhi mutla' nahin karta hai
Magar jis Rasool ko pasand kar le to us ke aage peechhe nigehbaan farishte muqarrar kar deta hai
Taake woh dekh le ke unhon ne apne Rabb ke paighaamaat ko pahuncha diya hai, aur woh jis ke paas jo kuchh bhi hai us par haawi hai aur sab ke a'daad ka hisaab rakhne waala hai
